exposure: gestational age at delivery (22-24 weeks, 24-26 weeks, 26-28 weeks, 28-32 weeks, 32-34 weeks, >34 weeks)
cohort: The study included 42,821 mothers who gave birth between 22 and 37 weeks in metropolitan France in 2019.
finding: Early gestational age at delivery was associated with an increased risk of severe maternal morbidity in women with preterm delivery, with the risk appearing linear.
mod_finding: Severe maternal morbidity was also found to be increased in cases of spontaneous prematurity and vaginal delivery.
